objections.claim: E6 makes an authoritative required gate probabilistic: its concealed random schedule explicitly permits an input-ignoring oracle to pass with probability up to 1/C(36,12). Recording the random draws makes a completed run reproducible but does not prevent the initial false-green admission, so identical governed content can receive different gate verdicts and a nondiscriminating oracle can authorize by chance. This violates the frozen fail-closed requirement and the repository's deterministic-gate boundary. Randomized mutation testing may be supplemental, but authority must rest on a deterministic discriminator (for example, exhaustive evaluation of a closed finite domain or another deterministically complete enforcement mechanism).
